title: Clautreaux Possible NDE 4954
content: I was walking on a hazy path, enveloped in foul odors and suffering. The horizon was dark brown and twilight prevailed. This lasted, and lasted... Then the pains began to ease, the odors became perfumed, and the colors went progressively from brown to a clear blue and I was very happy to be going where I was going. Suddenly a shadow started walking on my right side. That lasted some time, and I was more and more happy, without pain anywhere. The shadow at my side spoke to me, asking, 'Are you sure you want to go on?' I went on a few paces, and then I turned around, without replying, and began to go back where I had come from. My sufferings revived, and the fragrance became disgusting odors and the colors became dark again. I woke up very angry, furious, furious to have 'returned'. I still feel the same, to some extent.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Eclatement de l'aorte Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) Cardiac arrest.
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness Throughout this 'journey'.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Disgusting odors, dark colors and intense suffering at first. Then, perfumes, light colors and wellbeing.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes A 'shadow' walked beside me and spoke to me. I don't know who it was; I just saw a 'shadow'. 'It' asked me if I really wanted to 'continue'.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes The horizon was dark at the beginning, then as I walked on, became light, blue.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Suffering, sadness, then great, immense, colossal joy on 'going where I was going', then rage and sadness at having to 'return where I had come from'.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I am much more easy-going with everybody. I never get angry anymore.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I am much more easy-going with everybody. I never get angry anymore. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Uncertain The mixture of anger and rage on awaking after nine days of coma.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The moment of my 'decision' to retrace my steps.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes After three months. And my wife then understood why I was so bad-tempered when I woke up.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I became aware that we will only die IF WE DECIDE TO?
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real I 'really' walked this path, and a 'shadow' 'really' asked me if I wanted to continue.
